mids.name: mid1
mids.title: What Do They Know on the Other Side of the River?
mids.card: From The Greater Journey, EP 14 with Brock Valentine
mids.desc: Brock Valentine grew up in the DC projects with a stutter, a 10-minute drive from multimillion-dollar homes in Virginia that nobody in his neighborhood would visit. He wanted to know what they knew over there. Here's what a cable job, a stranger's blunt advice and years of failure taught him.

mids.name: mid2
mids.title: Most of Us Quit Before We Conquer the Season
mids.card: From The Greater Journey, EP 14 with Brock Valentine
mids.desc: Brock Valentine kept buying trainings until a speaker asked who had actually done a deal. He shares the advice that moved him from learning to doing, the routine that keeps him grounded ("dominate the dirt"), and the four stages of every goal: the call, the climb, the conquering and the crown. Most of us quit right before we conquer.

Sports coats, jeans and Cole Haan (keeps "I don't overthink it")

mids.name: mid3
mids.title: The SCORE Principle: Why You're Stuck Even With All the Skills
mids.card: From The Greater Journey, EP 14 with Brock Valentine
mids.desc: Have all the skills and still stuck? Brock Valentine's SCORE principle (skills, consistency, observation, resourcefulness, enthusiasm) shows where you're falling short. Then Greg finds his own gift, and why enthusiasm plus consistency is enough to grow a business.
removed: Greg repeating the enthusiasm-and-consistency point (keeps "my natural gift is encouragement… Romans 12")

mids.name: mid4
mids.title: He Stuttered Until 27. Then He Learned to Serve Instead.
mids.card: From The Greater Journey, EP 14 with Brock Valentine
mids.desc: Speech therapy never fixed Brock Valentine's stutter. Speaking to a church of about 2,000 did, once he stopped focusing on himself. He shares why he left a job that wanted to keep him, the new normal he wanted for his family, and the one step to take today if you feel stuck.
